title: hazina iliyozama chini ya kiburi
intro: Hebu fikiria kusimama mbele ya rundo la utajiri mkubwa kiasi kwamba kubeba funguo tu kungechosha kundi la watu wenye nguvu. Sauti zinazokuzunguka zinahimiza unyenyekevu na ukumbusho, lakini kiburi kinaongezeka zaidi kuliko shukrani. Nini hutokea wakati fadhila inakuwa mtihani na kiburi kinafunga matokeo?
clues: Mimi nilikuwa miongoni mwa watu wa Musa, lakini niliwaasi.
Nilipewa hazina kubwa sana kiasi kwamba funguo zake zingelemea kundi la watu wenye nguvu.
Watu wangu walinishauri nisifurahi na kutafuta Akhera bila kusahau sehemu yangu ya ulimwengu huu.
Nilidai kwamba kile nilichokuwa nacho nilipewa kwa sababu tu ya ujuzi niliokuwa nao.
Nilitembea mbele ya watu wangu nikiwa nimevaa pambo, na wale waliotamani maisha ya dunia walitamani kama nilivyo nayo mimi.
Nilimezwa na ardhi pamoja na makao yangu, na hakuna aliyeweza kunisaidia wala kujisaidia.

arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
